original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_GB_INLET1 and TEMP_GB_INLET2 as two distinct GPU-baseboard inlet-air locations with correct spatial/NVGPU association, complete cross-path identity and approved absolute and inter-zone temperature acceptance.
original_method: The mechanical/thermal owner maps each inlet probe to a physical upstream airflow zone and any served GPU bank, provides absolute limits and an allowable inlet1-to-inlet2 delta; automation passively enumerates both records and reconciles IB/OOB/Web.
manual_activity: The thermal owner maps inlet1/inlet2 to exact upstream airflow zones and any GPU banks, defines ambient placement and approved absolute/delta criteria, and confirms Web entries. No fan or workload change is authorized.
required_inputs: GB/chassis revision, airflow direction and inlet1/inlet2 mechanical coordinates
Probe type/mounting and proof that both are upstream of their served heat sources
Any NVGPU bank, module serial/UUID/BDF or cooling-zone association
Exact SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mapping per inlet
Units, scale, accuracy, tolerance, sample/freshness and response lag
Absolute range/threshold and maximum approved inlet1-to-inlet2 delta by fan mode, ambient and altitude
Same-target IB/OOB identity and BMC/SDR/GB/GPU revisions
Secret-safe complete collectors and independent thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Bind exact row 1882 and exclude the duplicate BF3 transceiver workflow
Enumerate INLET1 and INLET2 separately; never query the tilde name as one sensor
Verify physical upstream placement and do not infer NVGPU association
Do not execute the parenthesized NVGPU annotation
Retain complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus Web before derived filtering
Do not start workload, reload driver, alter fans/power/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs; stop on airflow fault, unsafe inlet or mismatch
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact source/variant, duplicate isolation and two-probe airflow map
Record passive ambient, fan, load and any approved GPU-zone identity
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus both exact inlet records and Web
Compute only owner-approved absolute and delta comparisons with synchronized timestamps
Perform no annotation execution, BF3 substitution, fan/load change or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve inlet1/inlet2 coordinates, airflow zones and probe semantics
Provide absolute limits, delta tolerance and operating conditions
Review both sensors and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve both exact inlet names and use complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus Web, preserving airflow and ambient context without changing fans or load.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES DUAL-INLET SPATIAL MAP, AIRFLOW CONDITIONS AND ABSOLUTE/DELTA CRITERIA
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a two-row probe map on the airflow drawing and a synchronized snapshot to check each absolute value plus owner-approved left/right or zone imbalance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds spatial completeness and inter-zone asymmetry detection instead of treating two inlet names as interchangeable readings.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: TEMP_BF3_Trans and downstream RTM sensors cannot substitute for either upstream inlet location.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: One inlet may be affected by recirculation or rack hot-aisle leakage; an acceptable average can hide a localized over-temperature if per-probe and delta checks are omitted.

project_override_considerations: If the SKU has one inlet probe, the second index needs explicit N/A approval. If probes represent different airflow zones by design, the delta criterion must reflect that asymmetry rather than assume equality.
expected_evidence: Mechanical airflow drawing with two probe coordinates and served zones
Any NVGPU-bank relationship and probe calibration/type
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus two exact results
Per-probe unit/state/freshness, ambient/fan/load context, absolute limits and approved delta
BMC Web evidence plus passive power/GPU/SEL status
Same-target proof, statuses, hashes and annotation-handling audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1882 consistently targets two GB inlet sensors. Spatial/NVGPU mapping and criteria are missing inputs; the same-code BF3 transceiver row is a separate variant.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The dual-inlet passive verification is identifiable after owner-supplied map and limits under ED-35/36.

review_improvement: Isolates BF3, expands both inlet members and adds spatial airflow and inter-probe delta acceptance so a local hot inlet cannot be hidden by the other channel.
independent_technical_reasoning: Two inlet probes are valuable because cooling boundaries can be nonuniform; rack recirculation or obstruction may heat one zone while the other remains normal. Each probe therefore needs a fixed coordinate and absolute limit, plus a justified cross-zone delta rather than a single averaged judgment.
